provenance.statement: The owner confirms these illustrations were created for ApocalypseGearLab without reproducing third-party photographs and authorizes their commercial use.
provenance.scope: Only the fourteen images from this supplied ZIP; no product safety, listing, certification or Amazon participation approval is granted.
provenance.source: Owner reply to the provenance question during finalisation

assets.alt: Concept illustration of Fenix HM50R V2.0 rechargeable headlamp in an amber inventory frame
assets.reviewNote: Compared with the official Fenix Lighting HM50R V2.0 image: black detachable right-angle body, end switch, clip and black/orange strap agree. The body marking HM50R also appears in the official V2 image. Rendered microtext is not a revision, LED or battery specification.

assets.sourceOriginalName: Kit de survie d’urgence sous néons rouges(1).png
assets.alt: Concept illustration of SOL Emergency Bivvy with rescue whistle in a red inventory frame
assets.reviewNote: Compared with official orange standard Emergency Bivvy packaging and product photos. Orange reflective bag, package family and whistle/cord agree in general appearance. Depicted packaging and 90% text are not independent thermal evidence or a temperature rating.

assets.sourceOriginalName: Multitool Leatherman futuriste sous néons rouges(1).png
assets.alt: Concept illustration of Leatherman Wave+ multi-tool in a red inventory frame
assets.reviewNote: Unsuitable for commercial publication: deployed scissors, small driver and opener shapes/proportions are distorted compared with the official Wave Plus implement layout. Exact geometry cannot be corrected reliably without altering the source. Preserve file privately and use neutral artwork.

assets.sourceOriginalName: Filtre Sawyer dans une ambiance sci-fi rouge(1).png
assets.alt: Concept illustration of Sawyer Squeeze SP129 water filtration system in a red inventory frame
assets.reviewNote: Compared with Sawyer Squeeze component photo: black filter with blue branding, pouches, syringe, tubing and mesh bag are consistent with the documented family. This conceptual arrangement does not establish the current SP129 Canadian accessory inventory or filtration performance.

assets.sourceOriginalName: Kit médical de survie futuriste rouge(1).png
assets.alt: Concept illustration of NANUK 904 first aid kit in a red inventory frame
assets.reviewNote: Compared with official red 904 filled-kit photographs and USA sheet: hard case, handle, latches, lid organizer and divided fill agree in general appearance. Contents are illustrative; exact count, sterile supplies and Canadian package are unverified and explicitly qualified on the profile.

assets.alt: Concept illustration of Reliance Aqua-Tainer 7-gallon water container in a red inventory frame
assets.reviewNote: Unsuitable for commercial publication: side copy is malformed and includes an unverified 22.7 kg / 50 lb marking, while the face invents a 5-year warranty claim not established by the reviewed source. The manufacturer currently labels the 7G model 26 L; the illustration says 26.5 L. No capacity or warranty evidence is taken from this artwork. Use a neutral placeholder.

assets.alt: Concept illustration of a red Midland emergency radio in an amber inventory frame
assets.reviewNote: Housing, solar panel, six controls and flashlight are consistent with the official ER310 view. Rendered screen digits are illustrative, not evidence of tuning, reception or Canadian Weatheradio service.

assets.alt: Concept illustration of a black and orange Jackery Explorer 300 power station
assets.reviewNote: Rejected: the artwork still shows USB-C 100 W instead of the documented 60 W, USB-A 15 W, a circular screen graphic and POWER label. This is not a corrected replacement.

assets.alt: Concept illustration of a black INIU power bank with display and detachable cable in an amber frame
assets.reviewNote: Housing, display, side button and cable arrangement match the manufacturer P62 family reference. This does not verify the exact listing revision, battery safety, certification or advertised output.

assets.alt: Concept illustration of a grey and black EcoFlow power station in an amber frame
assets.reviewNote: Housing, three USB-A plus USB-C layout, display, DC group and four AC outlets are consistent with the official RIVER 2 Pro view. Small screen text is not technical evidence.

assets.sourceOriginalName: Station d’énergie Jackery futuriste en lumière orange(2).png
assets.alt: Concept illustration of a black and orange Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 power station
assets.reviewNote: Same composition as the previously reviewed illustration: housing, handle, lamp and connector arrangement are consistent with the official v2 reference. The official badge also omits v2; rendered screen text does not establish technical facts.

assets.alt: Concept illustration of a camouflage Fenix camping lantern in an amber inventory frame
assets.reviewNote: Same composition as the previously reviewed CL26R Pro illustration. Diffuser, control dial and camouflage body are consistent with the official reference; the upper serial-style marking is not an authenticated model or serial number.

assets.sourceOriginalName: Alarme Kidde futuriste sous éclairage ambré-2(1).png
assets.alt: Concept illustration of a white Kidde carbon monoxide alarm in an amber frame
assets.reviewNote: Housing, three LEDs, Test/Reset button and three ventilation openings are consistent with the official US C3010 photo. This does not establish Canadian C3010-CA identity or certification; the product safety hold remains.

assets.sourceOriginalName: Panneau solaire Jackery, affichage tactique futuriste(6).png
assets.alt: Concept illustration of a four-section folding Jackery solar panel in an amber frame
assets.reviewNote: Four-panel folding layout, corner fasteners, grey cells and side Jackery label are consistent with the official SolarSaga 100 Air view. Exact package and electrical compatibility remain separate checks.
